entries.title: Olympic Champion Missy Franklin Explains Her Shoulder Problems: GMM presented by SwimOutlet.com
entries.visualNotes: Original interviewer and athlete; transcript at 2:54 identifies 2016 shoulder injury and bilateral surgeries. Preserve self-report; avoid interpreting transcription error as failed surgery.

entries.title: Gabriel Medina’s magnificent return to the CT: "I’ve been here before" | [Inside Pro Surfing]
entries.visualNotes: Original WSL interview: 0:32 identifies 2025 season injury; 0:43 athlete describes chest muscle injury. Return retrospective, not whole-video injury footage.

entries.title: J.J. Watt exclusive ESPN interview on returning for Texans’ playoff run from injury | NFL on ESPN
entries.visualNotes: Original ESPN interview with Lisa Salters; transcript 1:54-3:13 covers tackle, pectoral injury and subsequent surgery. His personal risk decision is not return-to-play advice.

entries.title: Zoey Clark: Fighting Back - A short documentary
entries.visualNotes: Athlete interview observed; 1:47-2:38 transcript explicitly describes January indoor-season symptoms, MRI and nerve symptoms. Remains attributed self-report, not independently confirmed peripheral nerve category.

entries.title: Olympic gold medalist Chloe Kim announces she dislocated her shoulder
entries.visualNotes: 15.881-second original NBC News short, completed once and replayed. Narrated injury announcement with short training fall excerpt; classify news, not continuous injury-motion footage.

entries.title: How I BROKE My Foot!
entries.visualNotes: Athlete vlog day of gym injury; description explicitly links foot fracture and missed World Championships. At11:40 describes ankle roll and pain before diagnosis. Screenshot confirms first-person post-training commentary. Source afterward establishes foot fracture; not swimming-mechanism footage.

entries.title: Gstaad Major: This just might have been Kerri Walsh’s greatest comeback!
entries.visualNotes: Original event interview at0:00-0:18 explains shoulder coming out and uncertainty whether on swing/missed ball; later match continuation. Do not assert exact injury instant or advise reduction/continuing play.

entries.title: Rafael Nadal Withdraws from Wimbledon Due to Injury | Press Conference | Wimbledon 2022
entries.visualNotes: Official Wimbledon press conference; athlete states abdominal muscle tear and withdrawal at0:20-0:48; scene verified. Precise onset unknown.

entries.title: From ACL Injury To PARIS OLYMPICS | Jordyn Poulter Interview (VNL 2024)
entries.visualNotes: Original on-site athlete interview; 0:32-0:38 identifies December2022 multiligament knee injury and rehabilitation. Do not expand auto-caption ligament abbreviations into diagnosis list.

entries.title: Paula Badosa Press Conference | 2024 US Open Round 4
entries.visualNotes: 2024 official press conference, athlete seen discussing back injury response at4:27. Retrospective after2023 injury, not a new2024 fracture or injury instant.

entries.title: Nadal feels physically good after recovery from rib injury to take part in Madrid Open | MMOPEN
entries.visualNotes: Short press-conference interview about rib injury and Madrid return; athlete reports doctors/tests. Individual self-report does not establish generally risk-free return. Separate from later abdominal tear.

entries.title: Karsten Warholm Injured, Suspects Hamstring Tear
entries.visualNotes: Original FloTrack presenter analysis, NOT athlete interview; discusses Rabat event and initial suspected hamstring tear. Use subsequent sourced diagnosis, do not repeat presenter speculation as clinical fact.

entries.title: Jake Wightman On His Return From Injury, Why He Thinks He Can Still Beat Jakob Ingebrigtsen
entries.visualNotes: Athlete describes January South Africa training and hurdle-hop landing at5:35-6:28; original interview screenshot confirms identity. Do not label as overuse or specify conflicted tissue diagnosis.

entries.title: Molly Seidel on the other side of injury and looking ahead to fall marathon
entries.visualNotes: Original athlete interview; transcript4:58 says broke knee and January preceding Olympic trials. Patella diagnosis attributed to original iRunFar interview, not inferred from video.

entries.title: UFC 263: Paul Craig Octagon Interview
entries.visualNotes: 同場勝方 Paul Craig 接受 Joe Rogan 訪談，約1:03起談 armbar；看到的是訪談畫面，不是 Hill 本人受訪。主播當下說 broken 不採為診斷，後續 UFC 本人訪談確認肘脫臼。

entries.title: Full Blast: Munoz & Mitrione - Mir vs Nogueira
entries.visualNotes: Full Blast 分割畫面為 Munoz/Mitrione 觀賽反應，2:00–2:24評論降服及手臂傷勢；不是受傷本人訪談，不能標成清楚比賽傷害回放。骨折位置依後續教練原訪談，不沿用節目猜測肩脫臼。

entries.title: UFC: Frank Mir vs. Tim Sylvia | June 19, 2004
entries.visualNotes: 完整 UFC 48 原場比賽與重播，8:50起討論並重播手臂受控、裁判制止片段。畫面不能指定骨頭；右臂骨折由 UFC 事後官方回顧確認。

entries.title: UFC 262: André Muniz Octagon Interview
entries.visualNotes: 勝方 André Muniz 賽後訪談，2:09–2:31談聽到手臂聲響而鬆手；截圖為訪談並無清晰傷害回放。不是 Souza 本人訪談；骨折診斷採醫療團隊原始採訪。

entries.title: Tom Aspinall Talks Octagon Return, Heavyweight Division & More | FULL INTERVIEW w/ John Gooden
entries.visualNotes: UFC John Gooden 本人專訪。15:33起談早於 UFC 的同膝問題及2022受傷、手術；不可將所有韌帶問題說成單次踢擊全新造成。與另一膝的舊手術不同。

entries.title: Jordan Burroughs looks back on winning a World title four weeks after breaking his ankle
entries.visualNotes: 原創現場訪談，0:07明指2013，0:36本人談踝骨折與手術。回顧而非受傷瞬間；個人帶傷參賽不當作治療建議。

entries.title: The Passion Never Went | EXCLUSIVE Jofra Archer Interview | Injuries, Playing For England & Future
entries.visualNotes: ECB 傷後復出原創本人訪談；2023返回國際比賽的回顧涵蓋多段傷勢，不把整段缺賽歸因於單一2020肘傷。無可見字幕按鈕，未逐字核實語音；臨床診斷來自另列ECB醫療公告。

entries.title: Pacquiao undergoes surgery for injured shoulder
entries.visualNotes: ABS-CBN 原創肩傷手術新聞，畫面為傷後抵達等新聞素材。影片說明明列右肩旋轉肌袖在 Mayweather 比賽加劇；沒有受傷當下可判讀機轉的鏡頭。

entries.title: It’s been an insane journey | Sky Brown on winning Olympic bronze after dislocating her shoulder
entries.visualNotes: 約1:33起記者問肩傷影響，Sky 本人1:47–2:02談原先脫臼、預賽再跌及預計手術。2024巴黎賽後採訪；不把記者自述滑雪脫臼史當成選手病史。

entries.title: Tony Hawk Recounts his Bad Fall at the Ramp; Straight from the Hospital to the Podcast!
entries.visualNotes: 本人節目與 Jason Ellis 回顧坡道失誤；4:23–4:44描述落地與腿部異常；19:22具名 femur。不是2022受傷動作連續鏡頭，也不混入20:01所提2004骨盆舊傷。

entries.title: Helen | Believe
entries.visualNotes: WGN 原創本人視訊訪談，2:29起談腦傷影響；新聞開頭說2016兩年後受傷。紀錄片/訪談跨越多次腦震盪，事件本頁只記2018初次，不將後續所有症狀歸因於單次事故。

entries.title: Asian Games 2023 Day 7: Mirabai Chanu injured
entries.visualNotes: Oneindia 原創 Hindi 主播報導，0:25–0:52討論最後試舉傷勢與協助離場。畫面為主播分析；不從其敘述推斷脊椎傷或韌帶斷裂，傷勢部位採原始現場採訪所述髖/大腿。

entries.title: Annemiek van Vleuten: The Last Interview | Movistar Team - 2023
entries.visualNotes: 本人隊伍專訪4:38–4:54明指Wollongong帶肘骨折奪冠；2023回顧的是2022世錦賽，不是新肘傷。個人帶傷比賽不代表安全回場條件。

entries.title: Daniel Andre Tande is back! | FIS Ski Jumping
entries.visualNotes: FIS 官方傷後回歸短訪，畫面是選手坐在沙發受訪；說明明列Planica季末摔傷。未取得字幕，傷勢診斷採FIS鎖骨手術公告，不由昏迷推定特定腦傷。

entries.title: Egan Bernal: The Best Day of my Life | INEOS Grenadiers behind the scenes
entries.visualNotes: 隊伍原創傷後騎車與本人旁白，0:21起談公路事故、呼吸困難及股骨處置；2:02談重返騎車。將多處外傷記為一個2022訓練事故，不把自述急救動作做一般人操作指引。

entries.title: The Real Price of the Podium: Connor Fields on Recovery, Identity, and the Power of Choice
entries.visualNotes: 原創Podcast本人訪談24:43起明指2021東京摔車及多處傷勢，25:01談腦傷及昏迷。勿把主持人4分鐘左右的癱瘓疾病史當成Connor病史；不從提及CTE推定選手CTE。

entries.title: Novak Djokovic Wimbledon 2017 quarter-final press conference
entries.visualNotes: 官方退賽記者會開頭本人澄清是肘、不是肩，已困擾一年半；0:48指出發球與正拍疼痛。慢性問題在2017賽事加劇，不假定7月12日才首次受傷或特定韌帶/骨傷。

entries.title: Nishikori On The Comeback Trail
entries.visualNotes: ATP原創回歸紀錄0:08說去年8月腕傷停賽，0:21本人談復健及選擇不手術；非手術建議，也非2018新傷。

entries.title: Bianca Andreescu Injury Update | Tennis Channel Live
entries.visualNotes: Tennis Channel 原創演播室討論與選手傷後貼文，報導當時仍等待檢查結果；不得以主持人看法判斷韌帶。兩條韌帶資訊來自後续WTA本人更新。

entries.title: Del Potro Opens Up About Wrist Injury Shanghai 2017
entries.visualNotes: 原創賽後採訪本人0:11–0:33談跌倒手腕落地、等待MRI。診斷挫傷採後續AP經紀人說法；不以當下不確定性推斷骨折。

entries.title: Rafael Nadal Withdraws from 2016 Roland-Garros
entries.visualNotes: 官方退賽本人記者會，0:10–0:30明指手腕數週症狀且抵達巴黎前已有痛。1:36 not broken/繼續打可能惡化不能當作已斷裂。影片是公告不是受傷當下。

entries.title: Une séance avec Nikola Karabatic
entries.visualNotes: PSG官方2021術後復健訓練紀錄，69秒看到敏捷梯訓練；沒有2020比賽受傷瞬間。節目說明明列膝部術後復健，不能將展示動作直接當成一般人復健處方。

entries.title: Injury Update: Kelly Slater Breaks Foot During Free Surf Session - Corona Open J-Bay 2017
entries.visualNotes: WSL同日傷後現場本人說明和足部冰敷，0:04明列free surf，非Round2比賽中受傷。當下等待X光；兩根蹠骨骨折來自後續WSL報導。

entries.title: One Of The Toughest Performances Ever - Sally Fitzgibbons Wins ’15 Fiji With A Busted Ear!!
entries.visualNotes: WSL 2015 Fiji 回顧，0:56–1:35醫療人員談鼓膜破裂並建議停賽；後續影片回顧包紮與帶傷比賽。不得把媒體讚揚韌性轉成鼓勵續賽，亦不推論腦震盪。

entries.title: Emma Raducanu to miss the French Open & Wimbledon after undergoing surgery on her wrists & ankle
entries.visualNotes: Sky原創新聞呈現本人手術聲明，0:32–0:58明列雙手骨傷持續約十個月。本頁只记雙腕/手傷，與同期踝手術分開；公告日期不是首次受傷日，未指認骨名。

entries.title: Tiger Woods’ 2008 U.S. Open Victory at Torrey Pines | Every Televised Shot | Champion’s Journey
entries.visualNotes: USGA官方2008美國公開賽逐球回顧；27:08播報員及本人談下肢疼痛，之後繼續賽事。疲勞性骨折發生於賽前，不能把任一揮桿標成骨折瞬間，也無法僅依畫面區分膝部旧傷與脛骨痛來源。
